title: Bound on a restricted Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and choose a coordinate set $J$, a subset $S$ of $J$, and a fixed sign assignment on the complementary coordinates. The absolute value of the resulting restricted Fourier coefficient is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: The target is a sign-valued function on $\{−1,1\}^n$
$J$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
A sign assignment on the complementary coordinates is fixed
